info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Training Management API
info.description: The Product Training Management API allows for the modification and enhancement of product training resources within the banking sector. This API primarily manages updates to existing training materials, ensuring that product information remains current and relevant for staff training purposes. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and training coordinators who need to maintain high-quality training programs. Use cases involve refining curriculum, updating training modules, and improving employee onboarding processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific product training session identified by PROD-700045. Use this operation to modify attributes such as training materials, schedules, and instructor information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the product training information for the specified product code (PROD-700045). It contains the necessary fields that need to be modified in the existing product training details.

200.description: The request was successful and the product information was updated.
